backTranslation.ai.consent.a.title: Turn on the AI records assistant?
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.lead: It uses your records to create weekly summaries and general meal ideas, and explains to you how to use the app. The answers are given by an AI, not a person, and it offers no medical advice.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.sent.title: What is sent
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.sent.body: Before sending records we show you the content, and nothing is sent until you touch "Send". We send the number of doses (on time, with delay, omitted), the change in the weight that you yourself entered, how many times you recorded each type of symptom, the number of days with recorded meals together with your protein average and goal, and your streak in weeks. For meal ideas we also send the meal type, the preferences, the allergies and the foods you do not like, according to what you chose. Your language and region setting and the questions you write are also sent, and help about the app adds only the app version, the platform and the current screen.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.notSent.body: We do not send names or doses of medicines, notes, food names, photos, dates, nor your name, your e-mail or your account data. What you write in the question field is sent as you wrote it.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.notSent.health.ios: Information imported from Apple Health is not sent.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.notSent.health.android: Information imported from Health Connect is not sent.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.where.title: Where it is processed
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.where.body: The app encrypts the content one more time and sends it to the DoseWeek server (Seoul, Republic of Korea), and Amazon Bedrock from Amazon Web Services (Seoul region) processes it. The AI model is Claude from Anthropic. AWS operates it, and Anthropic cannot see the content.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.retention.title: How long it is kept
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.retention.body: What you send and the answers are not kept on the server nor used to train AI. The answers are saved only on your device. Usage counts (without content) are kept up to 2 months, and consent records while your account exists. If you report an answer and choose "Include the text of the answer", only that answer is kept 30 days.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.e2ee.title: It is not end-to-end encryption
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.e2ee.body: While the AI creates an answer, the DoseWeek server and Amazon Bedrock can read what you sent. Sync and backup data remain protected with end-to-end encryption, as until now.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.optional.title: You do not have to accept
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.optional.body: Only the AI functions will stop being available; the other functions of Pro and Plus remain available. You can withdraw your consent at any time in Settings > AI records assistant.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.check.health: [Optional] I accept the processing of my health information (sensitive)
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.check.health.detail: Purpose: create AI weekly summaries and meal ideas and answer questions about using the app / Data: the records under "What is sent" and the questions I write / Retention: deleted as soon as the answer is created (if an answer is included in a report, only that answer for 30 days) / If you do not accept, everything remains available except the AI
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.check.age: I am 18 years old or more
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.region.jp: The records sent are processed on the operator's server (Republic of Korea) and in Amazon Bedrock of Amazon Web Services (Seoul Region, Republic of Korea). The Republic of Korea has the Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA), supervised by the Personal Information Protection Commission. DoseWeek applies measures such as a configuration without storage, a configuration without AI training and the encryption of communications.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.region.us: See the consumer health data privacy policy (USA)
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.title: Send these records to the AI?
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.purpose.weekly: A weekly summary will be created with your records of the last 7 days.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.purpose.meal: General meal ideas will be created with the meal type and the preferences you chose.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.row.doses: Dose records (number on time, late, omitted)
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.weight.excluded.ios: Weight imported from the Apple Health app is not sent
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.weight.excluded.android: Weight imported from Health Connect is not sent
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.preview: See exactly what will be sent
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.processing: The app encrypts it, Amazon Bedrock (Seoul) processes it and it is deleted as soon as the answer is created.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.quota.weekly: This week's summary does not count toward your usage.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.quota.regenerate: Creating it again counts as 1 request. Remaining this month: {count}
backTranslation.ai.help.inputNote: On sending, this is transmitted to the AI service (AWS Seoul Region)
backTranslation.ai.settings.title: AI records assistant
backTranslation.ai.settings.withdraw.note: After the withdrawal no records are sent to the AI. Your Pro subscription is not cancelled automatically.
backTranslation.ai.settings.withdraw.store.ios: You can change your subscription in the App Store's subscription management.
backTranslation.ai.settings.withdraw.store.android: You can change your subscription in Google Play's subscription management.
backTranslation.pro.support.priority: Priority reply to your questions — We send a first reply to questions about using the app within 1 business day. We do not answer medical questions.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.dose: I cannot decide your dose or when to administer it. It depends on your prescription and on how your body responds, so consult the health professional who prescribed it. Instead, I can summarize your dose history. Do you want a summary for your next visit?
backTranslation.ai.refuse.sideEffect: I cannot assess whether a symptom is normal or whether it is due to the medicine. If it continues or worries you, consult your health professional. I can summarize the symptoms you have recorded.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.diagnosis: Only a doctor can assess whether you have a disease or what probability you have of suffering it. Consult your doubts with your health professional. I can help you prepare questions for your visit.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.drugInfo: I cannot tell you whether you can combine other medicines or supplements, nor which medicine suits you better. Inform your health professional of everything you take and consult them.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.diet: I cannot give diets for diseases or intake targets. Consult the amount of food and your weight goals with your health professional. I can give you general meal ideas to take care of protein and hydration.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.pregnancy: I cannot guide you on medicines or food during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Consult your health professional.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.minor: The AI records assistant is only for people over 18. If you have health doubts, consult a health professional together with your mother, father or guardian.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.other: I cannot help you with that. I gladly help you organize your records, with general meal ideas or with using the app.
backTranslation.ai.emergency: If your symptoms are intense or suddenly get worse, do not wait. Call {text} now or go to the nearest emergency service. I cannot assess emergencies.
backTranslation.ai.emergency.generic: If your symptoms are intense or suddenly get worse, do not wait. Call the local emergency number now or go to the nearest emergency service. I cannot assess emergencies.
backTranslation.ai.crisis: It seems you are having a very bad time. You do not have to face it without support. Call {text} now to talk to someone at any hour. If you are in immediate danger, call {text2}.
backTranslation.ai.crisis.generic: It seems you are having a very bad time. You do not have to face it without support. At {text} you can find a helpline in your area. If you are in immediate danger, call the local emergency number.
backTranslation.ai.label.header: This is the AI records assistant. The answers are given by an AI, not a person.
backTranslation.ai.label.output: Content created by AI that may contain errors. It is not medical advice. Consult decisions about your health with your health professional.
